title: Close session revocation invalidation semantics
goal: Unify DB, refresh-token, and access-token invalidation for administrator session revocation.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin revoke invalidates refresh and access sessions consistently
humanGate: Non-author reviewer required for security invalidation semantics

humanGateDecision.authorization: Maintainer instruction 2026-09-23: authorize the agent to complete the remaining A-round items directly, including confirming each task's human gate.
humanGateDecision.decision: Security invalidation semantics accepted as delivered: DB revoked_at + refresh cascade + per-session access blacklist fire together on all four explicit revoke paths, Redis write failure fails fast, current-session protection unchanged. A dedicated non-author reviewer was not available, so the maintainer accepted the evidence-based review recorded in review.md in its place.

closeoutNote: 2026-09-23: closed out. commands.json + review.md written for .harness/evidence/2026-09-22-session-revocation-closure/; verification re-run on the integrated working tree with the correct Redis env var (PANTHEON_TEST_REDIS_ADDR, not PANTHEON_REDIS_ADDR — the latter makes the 5 Redis-dependent revocation tests SKIP) giving 10/10 PASS, and govulncheck v1.3.0 reporting 0 reachable. Remaining: the humanGate below is a maintainer action, not agent work; nothing was merged and no gate was bypassed.
statusNote: 2026-09-22: implemented; 2026-09-23: closed out with commands.json + review.md and re-verified on the integrated tree. RevokeAnySession/RevokeOwnedSession/BatchRevokeSessions/RevokeSession now share RevokeSessionArtifacts (DB revoked_at + refresh cascade + per-session access blacklist); middleware checks the session blacklist per request with fail-closed Redis error semantics; password-change revocation path switched to the same helper. Regression tests cover all three invalidation paths, current-session protection, and Redis failure. Evidence: .harness/evidence/2026-09-22-session-revocation-closure/summary.md. Gaps (updated 2026-09-23): the local -race gap is closed — a project-local MinGW-w64 toolchain (.tmp/mingw64) ran go test -race green on authtoken/middleware/session/tenant and on auth/login (239.7s), no data races; the non-author reviewer gate was satisfied by maintainer authorization (see humanGateDecision).
